SkillDescription.agility: Agility governs balance, movement, riding, evasion, and other feats of bodily control.
SkillDescription.care: Care covers crafts, treatment, leadership, trade, extracts, and practical professional work.
SkillDescription.entertainment: Entertainment covers performance, music, dance, storytelling, and games of chance.
SkillDescription.faith: Faith governs religious knowledge, invocations, divine power, and access to Holy Tablets.
SkillDescription.fighting: Fighting governs armed and unarmed combat, defensive reactions, and battle experience.
SkillDescription.knowledge: Knowledge covers languages, cultures, learning, religion, lore, and scholarly insight.
SkillDescription.shadowArts: Shadow Arts covers stealth, disguise, theft, traps, and covert observation.
SkillDescription.vitnerCraft: Vitner Craft governs perceiving, calling, and shaping vitner through spells and Vitner Tablets.
SkillDescription.wilderness: Wilderness covers travel, survival, hunting, navigation, nature, and seafaring.

KnowledgeDescription.strenuous: Strenuous lets the conjurer spend 2 additional Vitner Points per specialty level to gain +1 SV per amount spent when weaving a spell.

Seax.Name: Seax (Dagger or Knife)
Seax.Description: A ubiquitous single-edged knife used for work, ritual blood gifting, throwing, and as a last-resort weapon.

Glaaf.Name: Glaaf (Short Sword)
Glaaf.Description: A short sword, usually double-edged, common in eastern Trudvang and associated with the ancient Brots.

HringSeax.Name: Hring Seax (Ring Knife)
HringSeax.Description: A Mittlander fighting blade with a single inward-curving edge and a ring at the pommel, often tied to the wrist.

BattleAxe.Name: Barda Axi (Battle Axe)
BattleAxe.Description: A refined and enlarged hand axe designed for combat.

Broadsword.Name: Breid Swerd (Broadsword)
Broadsword.Description: A robust cutting sword, commonly wielded by Mittlander warriors and sometimes used as a paired weapon.

BeardedAxe.Name: Villtur Axi (Bearded Axe)
BeardedAxe.Description: A long-shafted Stormlander axe whose L-shaped blade widens the cutting surface without excessive weight.

LongSpear.Name: Spjot (Long Spear)
LongSpear.Description: An effective and inexpensive long spear, especially dangerous in disciplined formations or from horseback.

TwoHandedAxe.Name: Tvei Axi (Two-Handed Axe)
TwoHandedAxe.Description: A mighty two-handed axe. Fine examples use iron for both shaft and head.

TwoHandedSword.Name: Tvei Swerd (Two-Handed Sword)
TwoHandedSword.Description: A huge, heavy sword that sacrifices speed for reach, power, and terror on the battlefield.

HuntingBow.Name: Veidi Bogi (Hunting Bow)
HuntingBow.Description: A simple hunting bow. It deals full damage at short range and half damage at long range.

Longbow.Name: Lang Bogi (Longbow)
Longbow.Description: A heavy, composite Stormlander war bow with greater range and a more dangerous open damage roll.

Crossbow.Name: Krossbogur (Crossbow)
Crossbow.Description: A powerful defensive crossbow with excellent range but a slow loading cycle.

ThrowingAxe.Name: Throwing Axe
ThrowingAxe.Description: A light axe balanced for throwing with one hand.

FurLeather.Name: Fur / Leather Armor
FurLeather.Description: Warm, quiet armor of tanned fur or soft leather. It is common among Wildfolk, troll peoples, and northern humans.

HardenedLeather.Name: Hardened Leather Armor
HardenedLeather.Description: Leather boiled in oil and formed to the wearer. It is quieter than metal armor and offers moderate protection.

ChainMail.Name: Chain Mail
ChainMail.Description: Thousands of interlinked metal rings worn over padding. Mail is heavy but comparatively flexible.

PlateArmor.Name: Plate Armor
PlateArmor.Description: Rare, custom-fitted overlapping metal plates. Plate offers exceptional protection at severe weight and initiative cost.

SmallShield.Name: Small Wooden Shield
SmallShield.Description: A quick shield allowing three weapon actions per round. Shields are used primarily to parry successful melee attacks.

MediumShield.Name: Medium Wooden Shield
MediumShield.Description: A balanced shield allowing two weapon actions per round. On a successful parry, damage is applied to the shield.

LargeShield.Name: Large Wooden Shield
LargeShield.Description: A slow but highly protective shield allowing one weapon action per round.

AdventureKit.Name: Adventure Kit
AdventureKit.Description: A bundle of common expedition supplies. Make a Situation roll with a value of 10 to determine whether an ordinary kit contains a plausible item.

Rope.Name: Hemp Rope
Rope.Description: A practical length of hemp rope for climbing, binding, hauling, and camp work.

Torch.Name: Torch
Torch.Description: A resinous wooden torch providing portable light until consumed.

DragonBlood.Name: Dragon Blood
DragonBlood.Description: A legendary altering extract taken from a dragon. It is exceedingly rare and worth about 1,000 silver coins per dose.
DragonBlood.Effect: Roll 1d20 + extract Strength - Constitution. Mild, moderate, substantial, and complete effects grant +2, +4, +8, or +12 natural Protection Value for one day.

FrostboarFat.Name: Frostboar's Fat
FrostboarFat.Description: Thick brown fat cut from a frostboar's neck. It smells terrible and can be used without further preparation.
FrostboarFat.Effect: Rubbed on the body, the fat protects against extreme cold and heat for two hours. Determine its degree with the extract-effect roll.

WoundBalm.Name: Wound-Balm
WoundBalm.Description: A healing salve prepared for direct application to injuries.
WoundBalm.Effect: Apply the balm to a wound and resolve its healing degree with the standard extract-effect roll.

Manetter.Name: Manetter
Manetter.Description: A dangerous poison that slowly strangles its victim and ignores armor and natural protection.
Manetter.Effect: Roll 1d20 + 2 - Constitution and consult the Extract Effect table. Damage is removed directly from Body Points.

AnimalVitner.Name: Animal Vitner Tablet
AnimalVitner.Description: A Vitner Tablet concerned with speaking to, calling, controlling, possessing, and sending messages through animals.

FlameCraft.Name: Flame Craft Tablet
FlameCraft.Description: A Vitner Tablet governing sparks, heat, fire protection, flame control, and devastating seas of fire.

PowerThought.Name: Power of Thought Tablet
PowerThought.Description: A Vitner Tablet governing language, courage, fear, telepathy, memory, control, possession, and mind reading.

TabletShield.Name: Tablet of the Shield
TabletShield.Description: A Holy Tablet of the Tenet of Nid whose divine feats concern shelter, endurance, and protection.

Messenger.Name: Messenger
Messenger.Description: Imbues a small animal with a simple message and a destination it can reasonably reach.
Messenger.Effect: The animal attempts to travel to the named recipient and deliver the message. Extra levels of power can extend the message or distance.

SpeakAnimals.Name: Speak to Animals
SpeakAnimals.Description: Allows the enchanter to understand and communicate with a nearby animal.
SpeakAnimals.Effect: For the duration, the caster can exchange simple ideas with animals; intelligence and disposition still limit the conversation.

CallAnimals.Name: Call on Animals
CallAnimals.Description: Calls animals of a chosen general kind from the surrounding area.
CallAnimals.Effect: Nearby animals may travel toward the caster. Extra levels of power increase range, number, or duration as approved by the game master.

Spark.Name: Spark
Spark.Description: Creates a focused magical spark capable of igniting suitable tinder.
Spark.Effect: Ignites a small combustible target within range. It is not a full combat flame unless enhanced by levels of power.

BurningHand.Name: Burning Hand
BurningHand.Description: Wraps the caster's hand in searing magical flame for a close attack.
BurningHand.Effect: The touched target suffers magical fire damage determined by the spell's level of power; ordinary protection may be limited by the game master.

FlameBurst.Name: Flame Burst
FlameBurst.Description: Hurls a compact burst of flame that detonates at the selected point.
FlameBurst.Effect: Targets in the burst suffer fire damage. Additional levels of power can increase damage or area.

Courage.Name: Courage
Courage.Description: Strengthens a creature's mind against dread.
Courage.Effect: Reduces Fear Points or grants a bonus against fear for the duration, according to the spell's level of power.

Fear.Name: Fear
Fear.Description: Projects a terrifying thought directly into a target's mind.
Fear.Effect: The target gains Fear Points; Psyche and other protections may reduce the effect.

ArmedFighting.Name: Armed Fighting
ArmedFighting.Description: A Fighting discipline covering combat with manufactured weapons. Each level contributes +1 in applicable actions.

OneHandLight.Name: One-Handed Light Weapons
OneHandLight.Description: An Armed Fighting specialty. Each level contributes +2 when fighting with one-handed light weapons and adds locked Combat Points.

ShieldBearer.Name: Shield Bearer
ShieldBearer.Description: An Armed Fighting specialty. Its first level removes the normal shield-hand penalty when using shields; further levels improve shield use.

BattleExperience.Name: Battle Experience
BattleExperience.Description: A Fighting discipline covering combat awareness, initiative, armor use, and tactical maneuvers.

BodyControl.Name: Body Control
BodyControl.Description: An Agility discipline covering balance, controlled movement, evasion, and ambidexterity.

Horsemanship.Name: Horsemanship
Horsemanship.Description: An Agility discipline covering riding, mounted movement, and mounted combat.

HealingDrugs.Name: Healing and Drugs
HealingDrugs.Description: A Care discipline covering diagnosis, healing, extracts, poisons, potions, and treatment.

DivinePower.Name: Divine Power
DivinePower.Description: A Faith discipline that grants divinity capacity and access to Holy Tablets and divine feats.

VitnerShaping.Name: Vitner Shaping
VitnerShaping.Description: A Vitner Craft discipline used with Galding, Sejding, or Vyrding specialties to weave spells.

Survival.Name: Survival
Survival.Description: A Wilderness discipline covering prolonged travel, shelter, weather, food, and life beyond settled lands.

ExtractEffect.Name: Extract Effects
ExtractEffect.Substantial: Substantial effect (11-15), followed by moderate and mild
ExtractEffect.Complete: Complete effect (16-20), followed by each lower effect

FearLevel.Name: Fear Levels
FearLevel.One: Fear level 1 (1-10): uneasy, no universal modifier
FearLevel.Two: Fear level 2 (11-20): frightened, -1 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Three: Fear level 3 (21-30): horrified, -3 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Four: Fear level 4 (31-40): terrified, -5 SV and initiative
FearLevel.Five: Fear level 5 (41-50): petrified, -7 SV and initiative

DisciplineCost.Name: Discipline and Specialty Costs
DisciplineCost.One: Level 1: requires base SV 4; costs 7 points
DisciplineCost.Two: Level 2: requires base SV 7; costs 14 points
DisciplineCost.Three: Level 3: requires base SV 7; costs 21 points
DisciplineCost.Four: Level 4: requires base SV 10; costs 28 points
DisciplineCost.Five: Level 5: requires base SV 10; costs 35 points

FatalMagic.Name: Fatal Magic Effects
FatalMagic.E21: The enchanter becomes lethargic and apathetic, suffering -2 on everything for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E23: The enchanter loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E25: The enchanter suffers -2 on everything and loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d3 hours.
FatalMagic.E29: The enchanter suffers -2 on everything and loses 1d10 Vitner Points from their capacity (minimum 1) for 1d6 hours.
FatalMagic.E31: The enchanter loses 1d10 (OR 9-10) Vitner Points from their remaining capacity (minimum 1) for one day.
FatalMagic.E33: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d3 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E35: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 10 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E37: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d6 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E39: The enchanter loses one third of their vitner capacity for 1d3 days and suffers a visual negation (1d10): 1-2 bark skin; 3-4 doubled finger length; 5-6 grass hair; 7-8 local-animal fur; 9 the closest person suffers 1-8; 10 everyone within 10 meters suffers 1-8.
FatalMagic.E41: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 20 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E43: The failed spell absorbs vitner within 1d10 (OR 10) meters. Each creature loses 1d10 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E44: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Within 50 meters of another enchanter it flashes for 1d6 damage that ignores non-magical armor, losing equal strength until emptied.
FatalMagic.E45: The enchanter loses half their vitner capacity for 1d6 days and suffers a visual negation (1d10): 1-2 bark skin; 3-4 doubled finger length; 5-6 peat-moss hair; 7-8 local-animal fur; 9 the closest person suffers 1-8; 10 everyone within 10 meters suffers 1-8.
FatalMagic.E46: The enchanter becomes vitner-blind and cannot evoke spells for 1d6 days. Within 1d10 (OR 10) meters, each creature loses 1d6 Vitner Points; creatures without Vitner Points instead lose that many Body Points.
FatalMagic.E47: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Everyone within 1d10 (OR 10) meters is hit for 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor; each discharge drains 1d3 Vitner Points from the enclosure until emptied.
FatalMagic.E48: The enchanter loses their memory for 1d3 days and cannot evoke spells or perform skills.
FatalMagic.E49: A harmless light explosion empties the enchanter of vitner. Capacity drops to 1 and starts recovering after one week.
FatalMagic.E50: A vitner enclosure surrounds the enchanter. Everyone within 1d10 (OR 9-10) meters is hit for 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor; each discharge drains 1 Vitner Point until emptied.
FatalMagic.E51: The enchanter and every creature within 2d6 meters suffer 1d10 damage that ignores non-magical armor. The enchanter loses half their remaining Vitner Points and recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E52: The enchanter suffers Body Point damage equal to the spell's total vitner cost, falls unconscious for 1d10 minutes, and drops to 1 vitner capacity; recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E53: A blinding discharge forces everyone within 2d6 meters to pass a Psyche-modified Situation roll against 10 or go blind for 1d5 minutes. The enchanter suffers damage equal to the spell's vitner cost, falls unconscious for 1d10 (OR 9-10) minutes, and drops to 1 capacity; recovery starts after one week.
FatalMagic.E54: The enchanter suffers a minor stroke, takes 2d10 (OR 10) damage, and falls into a coma for 1d10 days.
FatalMagic.E55: The enchanter suffers damage equal to the spell's vitner cost and falls unconscious for 1d10 (OR 7-10) minutes; everyone within 2d6 meters suffers half that damage. Capacity drops to 1 and recovery starts after two weeks.
FatalMagic.E56: The enchanter suffers a severe stroke, takes 2d10 (OR 9-10) damage, loses one Intelligence step, and falls unconscious for 1d10 days.
FatalMagic.E57: An enormous negation absorbs 1d10 (OR 6-10) Body Points and empties all vitner. Capacity drops to 1 and recovery starts after two weeks.
FatalMagic.E58: The enchanter opens a fog portal to Bloodheim, which devours them.
FatalMagic.E59: The enchanter becomes a lightning orb that explodes after 2d6 action rounds. Everything within 50 meters suffers 1d10 (OR 7-10) Body Point damage; the enchanter disappears.
FatalMagic.E60: The enchanter becomes a black-energy orb that explodes after 1d6 action rounds. Everything within 100 meters suffers 1d10 (OR 5-10) Body Point damage and everything within 300 meters suffers half; the enchanter disappears.

FatalFailure.Name: Fatal Failure Effects
FatalFailure.E21: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 minutes and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E31: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 hours and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E36: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke 1d3 random abilities for 1d6 days.
FatalFailure.E41: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke the attempted ability for 2d6 days.
FatalFailure.E46: The dimwalker loses the knowledge and ability to invoke 1d3 random abilities for 2d6 days.
FatalFailure.E51: The dimwalker loses touch with spiritual power for 1d6 days and cannot use Divinity Points.
FatalFailure.E55: The gods permanently revoke the attempted ability; it will always fail.
FatalFailure.E57: The gods permanently revoke 1d3 random accessible abilities; they will always fail.
FatalFailure.E59: The god permanently refuses to grant the dimwalker any divine abilities.
FatalFailure.E60: The gods immediately destroy the blasphemer and revoke their very existence.

Galtir.Name: Galtir
Galtir.Description: A brutish tusked humanoid. This standard specimen has 23 Body Points, Dexterity -1, Intelligence -4, and Strength +2.

GiantSnake.Name: Giant Snake
GiantSnake.Description: A massive serpent with crushing coils, Hylja camouflage, and a paralyzing stare. Standard specimen: 95 Body Points.

GiantSpider.Name: Giant Spider
GiantSpider.Description: An ancient colossal spider able to throw webs, paralyze prey, and cocoon victims. Standard specimen: 95 Body Points.

Gryphon.Name: Gryphon
Gryphon.Description: A huge winged hunter combining an eagle's head and wings with a feline body. Standard specimen: 87 Body Points.

NightUlm.Name: Night Ulm
NightUlm.Description: A small winged blood-drinker whose numbing saliva can spread the dreaded rugtanne infection. Standard specimen: 25 Body Points.

ThornBeast.Name: Thorn Beast
ThornBeast.Description: An immense flying beast whose stench alone can inflict Fear Points. Standard specimen: 171 Body Points.

TrollBull.Name: Troll Bull
TrollBull.Description: A hulking Haminges-worshiping humanoid with horns, natural armor, and a devastating charge. Standard specimen: 58 Body Points.

Warg.Name: Warg
Warg.Description: A fast predatory quadruped whose bite can spread warg sickness. Standard specimen: 18 Body Points.

DeepBellow.Name: Deep Bellow
DeepBellow.Description: The galtir unleashes a violent bellow; nearby creatures may need to resist fear or distraction.

Fearless.Name: Fearless
Fearless.Description: The creature is unusually resistant or immune to ordinary sources of Fear Points.

Constricting.Name: Constricting (SV 10)
Constricting.Description: After surrounding a victim, the snake tightens its coils. The victim must break free or suffer crushing consequences.

ParalyzingStare.Name: Paralyzing Stare
ParalyzingStare.Description: The victim makes a Psyche-based Situation roll with Situation Value 6 or is paralyzed for 1d3 action rounds.

AttackWeb.Name: Attack Web (SV 9)
AttackWeb.Description: Throws a broad sticky web. A trapped victim needs a Strength-based Situation roll, usually against Situation Value 7, to break free.

AttackAbove.Name: Attack From Above
AttackAbove.Description: The gryphon exploits flight and momentum to strike from above before climbing away.

Bloodsucker.Name: Bloodsucker
Bloodsucker.Description: Once attached, the night ulm drains blood in subsequent rounds and may expose a human victim to disease.

TerrifyingStench.Name: Terrifying Stench
TerrifyingStench.Description: Creatures within 5 meters gain 1d10 open Fear Points from the overwhelming smell unless accustomed to it.

Charge.Name: Charge
Charge.Description: The troll bull begins combat with a horn-first rush capable of knocking victims down and increasing damage.

TrollHeart.Name: Troll Bull Heart
TrollHeart.Description: The creature's brutal vitality and protective rage make it exceptionally difficult to stop.

WargSickness.Name: Warg Sickness
WargSickness.Description: A bitten human may contract a transformative disease. A Constitution- and Psyche-based Situation roll is commonly required to resist it.

vitner-animal-vitner:speak-to-animals:1.Name: Speak to Animals

vitner-animal-vitner:control-animals:4.Name: Control Animals

vitner-animal-vitner:create-messenger:7.Name: Create Messenger
vitner-animal-vitner:create-messenger:7.Summary: The mage creates a messenger of flesh and blood, which can deliver its message to a predetermined destination.

vitner-animal-vitner:send-message:8.Name: Send Message

vitner-body-vitner:grip:0.Name: Grip

vitner-body-vitner:tipping:1.Name: Tipping

vitner-body-vitner:sense-of-smell:3.Name: Sense of Smell

vitner-body-vitner:vision-blindness:4.Name: Vision/Blindness
vitner-body-vitner:vision-blindness:4.Summary: This spell can increase the vision of the enchanted for the duration.

vitner-body-vitner:leather-skin:5.Name: Leather Skin

vitner-body-vitner:strengthen:8.Name: Strengthen

vitner-body-vitner:hasten:9.Name: Hasten

vitner-body-vitner:change-creature:11.Name: Change Creature

vitner-delusion-vitner:increase-sounds:3.Name: Increase Sounds
vitner-delusion-vitner:increase-sounds:3.Summary: The vitner is woven around a person or creature and begins to amplify every sound that the target makes.

vitner-delusion-vitner:traceless:4.Name: Traceless
vitner-delusion-vitner:traceless:4.Summary: The spell creates an energy that follows the enchanted person around, causing tracks or evidence they leave behind to fade and be swept away , leaving the land as it was before they passed by.

vitner-delusion-vitner:ghost-voice:5.Name: Ghost Voice
vitner-delusion-vitner:ghost-voice:5.Summary: The spell enables the enchanted character to throw their voice so it seems to come from a completely different place within range.

vitner-delusion-vitner:depict:6.Name: Depict
vitner-delusion-vitner:depict:6.Summary: By concentrating on an object, a being, or a person, the enchanter can evoke an exact duplicate of it.

vitner-delusion-vitner:camouflage:7.Name: Camouflage
vitner-delusion-vitner:camouflage:7.Summary: The spell causes the target, as well as their clothing and equipment, to completely blend into the surroundings.

vitner-delusion-vitner:landscape-illusio.Name: Landscape Illusion
vitner-delusion-vitner:landscape-illusio.Summary: The spell creates a massive sphere of illusion around the enchanter that mimics a desired landscape.

vitner-delusion-vitner:invisibility:11.Name: Invisibility
vitner-delusion-vitner:invisibility:11.Summary: The spell creates powerful camouflage that constantly changes its appearance based on the observer’s perspective.

vitner-dimvitner:animate-undead:0.Name: Animate Undead
vitner-dimvitner:animate-undead:0.Summary: This ritual creates a bond between Dimhall and a dead body or a skeleton, which results in the mage conjuring an undead slave from those remains.

vitner-dimvitner:hand-of-death:1.Name: Hand of Death
vitner-dimvitner:hand-of-death:1.Summary: The mage sucks life force out of a living creature, dealing damages.

vitner-dimvitner:dismiss-undead:2.Name: Dismiss Undead
vitner-dimvitner:dismiss-undead:2.Summary: Drives undead creatures away from the mage with repelling deathly power.

vitner-dimvitner:speak-to-undead:3.Name: Speak to Undead
vitner-dimvitner:speak-to-undead:3.Summary: The mage creates a thin bond of death between a corpse and Dimhall that permits the mage to speak with the spirit of the corpse.

vitner-dimvitner:tendril-of-dimhall:4.Name: Tendril of Dimhall

vitner-dimvitner:vitner-theft:5.Name: Vitner Theft
vitner-dimvitner:vitner-theft:5.Summary: Steals vitner energy from another creature and transfers it to the mage.

vitner-dimvitner:summon-wight:6.Name: Summon Wight
vitner-dimvitner:summon-wight:6.Summary: This ritual summons a dead person’s spirit and soul to haunt the living as a wight.

vitner-dimvitner:control-undead:7.Name: Control Undead
vitner-dimvitner:control-undead:7.Summary: The spell allows the mage to control the souls of one or more undead creatures, such as skeletons, disers (ghosts), wights, and draugr, but not demons.

vitner-dimvitner:darkness-of-dimhall:8.Name: Darkness of Dimhall
vitner-dimvitner:darkness-of-dimhall:8.Summary: The mage points at an area within range, which is then engulfed in the humid and clinging darkness of Dimhall.

vitner-flame-craft:heat-water:0.Name: Heat Water

vitner-flame-craft:spark:1.Name: Spark

vitner-flame-craft:flame-burst:3.Name: Flame Burst
vitner-flame-craft:flame-burst:3.Summary: The spell creates a sudden fire that ignites within 10 meters of the enchanter.

vitner-flame-craft:protection-from-fire:.Name: Protection from Fire

vitner-flame-craft:sea-of-fire:7.Name: Sea of Fire
vitner-flame-craft:sea-of-fire:7.Summary: The mage points to an area within range, and it suddenly explodes in a sea of flame.

vitner-perceiving:find-home:0.Name: Find Home
vitner-perceiving:find-home:0.Summary: The spell creates a spiritual bond between the enchanted and a location they have been to for at least six hours.

vitner-perceiving:retrace-tracks:1.Name: Retrace Tracks
vitner-perceiving:retrace-tracks:1.Summary: The spell allows the enchanted person to easily see their own footprints on the ground.

vitner-perceiving:detect-object:2.Name: Detect Object
vitner-perceiving:detect-object:2.Summary: The spell makes it possible for the enchanter to find designated objects within the range.

vitner-perceiving:orientation:3.Name: Orientation

vitner-perceiving:detect-being:4.Name: Detect Being

vitner-perceiving:detect-undead:5.Name: Detect Undead

vitner-perceiving:surrounding:6.Name: Surrounding
vitner-perceiving:surrounding:6.Summary: The spell makes it possible for the enchanter to reach out with their mind and immediately acquire a general but accurate picture of the near surroundings.

vitner-perceiving:map:7.Name: Map
vitner-perceiving:map:7.Summary: Like the Surrounding spell, this spell makes it possible for the enchanter to reach out with their mind and immediately acquire a general but accurate picture of the near surroundings.

vitner-power-of-thought:understanding-sc.Summary: The spell allows the enchanter to decipher a piece of scripture that they normally are unable to read.

vitner-power-of-thought:understanding-sp.Name: Understanding Speech

vitner-power-of-thought:courage:2.Name: Courage

vitner-power-of-thought:fear:3.Name: Fear

vitner-power-of-thought:telepathy:4.Name: Telepathy
vitner-power-of-thought:telepathy:4.Summary: The spell creates a mental link between the enchanter and a chosen person within range.

vitner-power-of-thought:ecstasy:5.Name: Ecstasy

vitner-power-of-thought:imagining:6.Name: Imagining

vitner-power-of-thought:memory:7.Name: Memory
vitner-power-of-thought:memory:7.Summary: Allows the enchanted creature to recall past events with supernatural clarity.

vitner-power-of-thought:creature-control.Name: Creature Control
vitner-power-of-thought:creature-control.Summary: The enchanter can control and direct an intelligent creature (not an animal) that is within range and line of sight.

vitner-power-of-thought:aura-of-power:9.Name: Aura of Power
vitner-power-of-thought:aura-of-power:9.Summary: The spell creates an aura of vitner around the enchanter that exudes incredible power, authority , and glory.

vitner-power-of-thought:possess-creature.Name: Possess Creature
vitner-power-of-thought:possess-creature.Summary: The spell enables an enchanter to transfer their consciousness into an intelligent being’s body.

vitner-power-of-thought:mind-reading:11.Name: Mind Reading
vitner-power-of-thought:mind-reading:11.Summary: The enchanter can read a creature’s memories simply by touching it.

vitner-power-of-vision:tracking:0.Name: Tracking

vitner-power-of-vision:scanning:1.Name: Scanning
vitner-power-of-vision:scanning:1.Summary: By touching an object and slipping into a trance, the enchanter can explore its memories through the astral plane.

vitner-power-of-vision:far-sight:2.Name: Far Sight

vitner-power-of-vision:seeing:3.Name: Seeing

vitner-power-of-vision:astral-voyage:5.Name: Astral Voyage

vitner-power-of-vision:read-vitner:6.Name: Read Vitner
vitner-power-of-vision:read-vitner:6.Summary: The spell gives the enchanter the ability to carefully observe the vitner patterns that surround an object or creature and discern any spells that have been woven over it.

vitner-power-of-vision:true-sight:7.Name: True Sight
vitner-power-of-vision:true-sight:7.Summary: This spell allows a humanoid or creature’s eyes to be enchanted such that they recognize the vitner patterns of illusion that surround beings and objects.

vitner-soil-craft:rock-throw:0.Name: Rock Throw
vitner-soil-craft:rock-throw:0.Summary: The enchanter picks up a small rock and throws it at a target within range.

vitner-soil-craft:shape-soil:1.Name: Shape Soil
vitner-soil-craft:shape-soil:1.Summary: Softens and reshapes nearby earth and soil according to the mage's will.

vitner-soil-craft:earthquake:2.Name: Earthquake
vitner-soil-craft:earthquake:2.Summary: The spell causes an area within the range to rumble with a single, heavy tremor.

vitner-soil-craft:quagmire:3.Name: Quagmire
vitner-soil-craft:quagmire:3.Summary: The spell creates a thick swamp in the form of a large circle with a diameter of 3 meters and a depth of 10 centimeters.

vitner-soil-craft:soil-blast:4.Name: Soil Blast
vitner-soil-craft:soil-blast:4.Summary: The enchanter picks up a handful of soil from the ground (or a pocket) and hurls it at a target within range.

vitner-soil-craft:soil-walk:5.Name: Soil Walk
vitner-soil-craft:soil-walk:5.Summary: The spell creates a coating of vitner around the target that pushes away any soil that comes close to them.

vitner-soil-craft:shape-stone:6.Name: Shape Stone
vitner-soil-craft:shape-stone:6.Summary: The spell transforms all kinds of stone and ore, making it soft and pliable like thick clay.

vitner-soil-craft:petrify-remove-petrifi.Name: Petrify/Remove Petrification
vitner-soil-craft:petrify-remove-petrifi.Summary: Turns a creature to stone or restores a petrified creature to flesh.

vitner-vitner-craft:channeling:0.Name: Channeling
vitner-vitner-craft:channeling:0.Summary: The enchanter can benefit from the help of others while weaving a spell.

vitner-vitner-craft:vitner-pouch:1.Name: Vitner Pouch
vitner-vitner-craft:vitner-pouch:1.Summary: The enchanter weaves vitner together to create an astral pouch.

vitner-vitner-craft:enchant-object:2.Name: Enchant Object
vitner-vitner-craft:enchant-object:2.Summary: The spell is woven over a designated object within range, which is then imbued with vitner that enhances its properties.

vitner-vitner-craft:anti-magic:3.Name: Anti Magic
vitner-vitner-craft:anti-magic:3.Summary: The spell creates a film of protective vitner around the target.

vitner-vitner-craft:enchant-being:4.Name: Enchant Being
vitner-vitner-craft:enchant-being:4.Summary: The spell weaves together a layer of beneficial vitner around a target within range.

vitner-vitner-craft:seal:5.Name: Seal
vitner-vitner-craft:seal:5.Summary: The magic in the Seal spell binds another spell within it, which is later added to an object.

vitner-vitner-craft:dispel-vitner:6.Name: Dispel Vitner
vitner-vitner-craft:dispel-vitner:6.Summary: The magic of the Dispel Vitner spell neutralizes a designated spell that has been woven over an object or being.

vitner-vitner-craft:trace-vitner:7.Name: Trace Vitner
vitner-vitner-craft:trace-vitner:7.Summary: The enchanter weaves the vitner in a way that reveals the origin of a spell or negation.

vitner-vitner-craft:wall-of-vitner:8.Name: Wall of Vitner
vitner-vitner-craft:wall-of-vitner:8.Summary: The enchanter forms a circular wall of vitner with a diameter of 2 meters.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:detect-composit.Name: Detect Composition

vitner-vitner-of-objects:waterproof:1.Name: Waterproof
vitner-vitner-of-objects:waterproof:1.Summary: The spell creates a watertight seal around organic materials such as fabric or leather, and seals the cracks between assembled planks or similar construction.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:bind:2.Name: Bind
vitner-vitner-of-objects:bind:2.Summary: The spell weaves the vitner of two objects together, binding them as if they were joined using an incredibly powerful glue.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:rust:3.Name: Rust
vitner-vitner-of-objects:rust:3.Summary: The enchanter touches an object, which immediately begins to rust if it is made of metal, crumble if it is made of stone, rot and fray if it is made of fabric, and so on.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:alarm-object:4.Name: Alarm Object
vitner-vitner-of-objects:alarm-object:4.Summary: The enchanter weaves a delicate fabric of vitner around an object, which will trigger an alarm woven into it the moment it is disturbed.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:unlock-lock:5.Name: Unlock/Lock
vitner-vitner-of-objects:unlock-lock:5.Summary: The spell works like a universal key that can open any locked doors, drawers, chests, or similar items.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:enlarge-reduce-.Name: Enlarge/Reduce Object
vitner-vitner-of-objects:enlarge-reduce-.Summary: The spell enlarges or reduces a designated object that is less than or equal to 2 dm³ (the shape of the object can be 1 cm thick, 40 cm wide, and 50 cm long, which is equal to 2,000 cm³ or 2 dm³).

vitner-vitner-of-objects:alter-object:7.Name: Alter Object
vitner-vitner-of-objects:alter-object:7.Summary: The spell affects any object with a size equal to or smaller than a large box.

vitner-vitner-of-objects:create-object:8.Name: Create Object
vitner-vitner-of-objects:create-object:8.Summary: Vitner Points This rare and powerful spell creates objects out of thin air.

vitner-water-craft:find-water:0.Name: Find Water
vitner-water-craft:find-water:0.Summary: By concentrating on the flow of all vitner, the enchanter can locate all water sources and bodies of water within range.

vitner-water-craft:purify-water:1.Name: Purify Water
vitner-water-craft:purify-water:1.Summary: The spell filters water and removes all dangerous and unhealthy substances from up to 10 liters of liquid.

vitner-water-craft:breathe:2.Name: Breathe
vitner-water-craft:breathe:2.Summary: The spell gives the enchanted gills on their neck, which allow them to breathe underwater just as easily as if they were in air.

vitner-water-craft:form-water:3.Name: Form Water
vitner-water-craft:form-water:3.Summary: By controlling the vitner that flows through a source of water within range, the enchanter can form and shape the water as desired.

vitner-water-craft:create-water:4.Name: Create Water
vitner-water-craft:create-water:4.Summary: The enchanter creates a fountain of water that spurts from a desired place in the ground.

vitner-water-craft:solid-water:5.Name: Solid Water
vitner-water-craft:solid-water:5.Summary: The enchanter controls the vitner in the water so that it forms a hard surface beneath the enchanted character’s feet.

vitner-water-craft:control-precipitation.Name: Control Precipitation
vitner-water-craft:control-precipitation.Summary: The spell can change the amount of precipitation that falls to the ground.

vitner-water-craft:water-walk:7.Name: Water Walk
vitner-water-craft:water-walk:7.Summary: The spell makes it possible for the enchanted person to walk on water as if it were solid ground, or walk through it underwater.

vitner-water-craft:wave-master:8.Name: Wave Master
vitner-water-craft:wave-master:8.Summary: The spell affects the water on a river, a lake, or an ocean so it becomes either a boon or a hazard for the ships and beings that traverse it.

vitner-wind-craft:purify-air:0.Name: Purify Air
vitner-wind-craft:purify-air:0.Summary: The spell filters all dangerous and unhealthy substances from the air around the enchanter in a 1-meter radius, making it possible to breathe safely.

vitner-wind-craft:wind-gust:1.Name: Wind Gust
vitner-wind-craft:wind-gust:1.Summary: The spell creates a small wind gust that the enchanter can use to blow away insects, small animals, or small objects (less than 1 kg).

vitner-wind-craft:fog:2.Name: Fog
vitner-wind-craft:fog:2.Summary: The enchanter creates a thick blanket of fog that rises from the ground or water at a designated location within range.

vitner-wind-craft:control-wind:3.Name: Control Wind
vitner-wind-craft:control-wind:3.Summary: The spell creates a blast of compressed air that rushes with incredible speed at one or more targets.

vitner-wind-craft:air-armor:4.Name: Air Armor
vitner-wind-craft:air-armor:4.Summary: Wraps the target in protective currents of compressed air.

vitner-wind-craft:lift:5.Name: Lift
vitner-wind-craft:lift:5.Summary: The spell creates controlled winds around the enchanted person, causing them to lift off the ground.

vitner-wind-craft:air-shield:6.Name: Air Shield
vitner-wind-craft:air-shield:6.Summary: The spell creates controlled flurries of wind around one or several characters, causing each of them to lift off the ground.

vitner-wind-craft:wind-blast:7.Name: Wind Blast
vitner-wind-craft:wind-blast:7.Summary: The spell creates a blast of compressed air that rushes with incredible speed at one or more targets.

vitner-wind-craft:storm:8.Name: Storm
vitner-wind-craft:storm:8.Summary: The spell creates a sudden storm, which swirls and blows away all trash, dust, insects, objects, and beings smaller than 50 kg that are within a 20-meter radius of the enchanter.

vitner-wind-craft:wind-catcher:9.Name: Wind Catcher
vitner-wind-craft:wind-catcher:9.Summary: By singing a special song, the mage can use creatures nearby to pass on a message.

vitner-witchcraft:uprooted-tree:0.Name: Uprooted Tree
vitner-witchcraft:uprooted-tree:0.Summary: The spell causes a tree to uproot and collapse.

vitner-witchcraft:phantom-plague:1.Name: Phantom Plague
vitner-witchcraft:phantom-plague:1.Summary: The mage can bewitch a victim so they begin to manifest all potential symptoms of a disease they fear.

vitner-witchcraft:fever:2.Name: Fever
vitner-witchcraft:fever:2.Summary: By simply pointing a finger at a victim within range, the mage can raise their internal body temperature dramatically.

vitner-witchcraft:curse-object:3.Name: Curse Object
vitner-witchcraft:curse-object:3.Summary: The curse is put on a single object within range, which then significantly decreases its traits when in use.

vitner-witchcraft:amnesia:4.Name: Amnesia

holy-haminges-power-of-trolls:troll-wit:.Name: Troll Wit
holy-haminges-power-of-trolls:troll-wit:.Summary: The bound spirit bestows such incredible courage upon the spirit conjurer that they are immune to gaining Fear Points during the duration.

holy-haminges-power-of-trolls:taken-by-t.Name: Taken by the Mountain
holy-haminges-power-of-trolls:taken-by-t.Summary: The spirit conjurer can whisper a task to any person within range.

holy-thuuldom-anvil-shock:anvil-shock:0.Name: Anvil Shock
holy-thuuldom-anvil-shock:anvil-shock:0.Summary: Makes a blunt weapon release an earth-shattering shock when it strikes.

holy-thuuldom-borjorn-s-hand:borjorn-s-h.Name: Borjorn's Hand
holy-thuuldom-borjorn-s-hand:borjorn-s-h.Summary: When the Thuul activates the rune, he receives guidance from the mountain that will aid him in the next action he undertakes.

holy-thuuldom-cave-spider-s-grip:cave-sp.Name: Cave Spider's Grip
holy-thuuldom-cave-spider-s-grip:cave-sp.Summary: The rune makes it possible for the Thuul to climb vertical walls.

holy-thuuldom-earthquake:earthquake:0.Name: Earthquake
holy-thuuldom-earthquake:earthquake:0.Summary: The spell causes an area within the range to rumble with a single, heavy tremor.

holy-thuuldom-fang-of-yukk:fang-of-yukk:.Name: Fang of Yukk
holy-thuuldom-fang-of-yukk:fang-of-yukk:.Summary: Empowers an inscribed weapon with the deadly bite of Yukk.

holy-thuuldom-gills-of-the-blackfish:gil.Name: Gills of the Blackfish
holy-thuuldom-gills-of-the-blackfish:gil.Summary: The rune makes it possible for the one bearing the sacred object to breathe underwater for the duration.

holy-thuuldom-hammer-fists:hammer-fists:.Name: Hammer Fists
holy-thuuldom-hammer-fists:hammer-fists:.Summary: Hardens the Thuul's fists into crushing weapons like smithing hammers.

holy-thuuldom-healing-rune:healing-rune:.Name: Healing Rune
holy-thuuldom-healing-rune:healing-rune:.Summary: The Thuul can heal himself or any other chosen person by placing the runeinscribed item on the wound.

holy-thuuldom-heat-of-the-depths:heat-of.Name: Heat of the Depths
holy-thuuldom-heat-of-the-depths:heat-of.Summary: The Thuul can place the rune-inscribed object on the ground and channel the heat of the mountain depths.

holy-thuuldom-labyrinth-blood:labyrinth-.Name: Labyrinth Blood
holy-thuuldom-labyrinth-blood:labyrinth-.Summary: Grants an instinctive supernatural sense for navigating tunnels and labyrinths.

holy-thuuldom-mark-of-brokk:mark-of-brok.Name: Mark of Brokk
holy-thuuldom-mark-of-brokk:mark-of-brok.Summary: When the Thuul activates the rune-inscribed object, it is able to miraculously repair broken or damaged items.

holy-thuuldom-power-of-repair:power-of-r.Name: Power of Repair
holy-thuuldom-power-of-repair:power-of-r.Summary: The Thuul can heal himself or any other chosen person by placing the runeinscribed item on the wound.

holy-thuuldom-scales:scales:0.Name: Scales
holy-thuuldom-scales:scales:0.Summary: The power from the rune stretches like a snakeskin of metal over the Thuul’s body.

holy-thuuldom-stoneling:stoneling:0.Name: Stoneling
holy-thuuldom-stoneling:stoneling:0.Summary: The Thuul connects a minor mountain spirit to a single stone the size of a fist.

holy-thuuldom-stone-to-clay:stone-to-cla.Name: Stone to Clay
holy-thuuldom-stone-to-clay:stone-to-cla.Summary: By placing the rune-inscribed item on a stone, the Thuul can transform the stone into soft clay (in the amount of 1 cubic meter of stone per rune level).

holy-thuuldom-stoneshape:stoneshape:0.Name: Stoneshape
holy-thuuldom-stoneshape:stoneshape:0.Summary: The Thuul and his gear seem to melt into the mountain when the rune is activated.

holy-thuuldom-well-of-water:well-of-wate.Name: Well of Water
holy-thuuldom-well-of-water:well-of-wate.Summary: The Thuul places the rune-inscribed object on the stone and creates a temporary source of mountain water in that location.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-frien.Name: Animal Friend
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-frien.Summary: Forest animals that are not sick or under magical control never willfully attack the chosen one, but instead respectfully walk away.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-track.Name: Animal Tracks
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-track.Summary: Whenever the Ihana chooses, they can leave the tracks of an animal when treading instead of their own prints.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:talk-to-anim.Name: Talk to Animals
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:talk-to-anim.Summary: The Ihana can communicate with animals.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:invisible-to.Name: Invisible to Animals
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:invisible-to.Summary: The chosen one can, when desired, become completely invisible to unintelligent animals.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-spiri.Name: Animal Spirit
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-spiri.Summary: The Ihana can become a reflection of their chosen animal, granting the dimwalker some of the animal’s personality and traits.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-maste.Name: Animal Master
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-maste.Summary: The Ihana can domesticate a wild animal or beast, getting it to act like a tame farm cat.

holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-shape.Name: Animal Shape
holy-toikalokke-animal-mind:animal-shape.Summary: The Ihana obtains a visible picture of the person or creature that trod the current path by examining its tracks, and can then follow those tracks without a problem.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:orientation:0.Name: Orientation
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:orientation:0.Summary: The spell makes it possible for the enchanter to find designated objects within the range.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:tree-walk:1.Name: Tree Walk
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:tree-walk:1.Summary: The Ihana can move among the trees at half their normal movement rate.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:hearing:2.Name: Hearing
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:hearing:2.Summary: By concentrating on a visual point within the designated range, the Ihana is able to hear everything within 10 meters of that point.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-leap:3.Name: Feline Leap
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-leap:3.Summary: The Ihana has the ability to leap with the incredible agility and grace of a feline.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-reflex.Name: Feline Reflexes
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:feline-reflex.Summary: The Ihana evades an incoming ranged attack.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:aim:5.Name: Aim
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:aim:5.Summary: When the Ihana attacks with ranged weapons, they can take extra aim at a target for the duration of the ability , gaining an additional +1 to the SV to strike the target.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:track:6.Name: Track
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:track:6.Summary: The Ihana obtains a visible picture of the person or creature that trod the current path by examining its tracks, and can then follow those tracks without a problem.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:concealment:7.Name: Concealment
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:concealment:7.Summary: The Ihana is able to blend in and become one with the background as desired for the duration of the ability.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:forest-path:8.Name: Forest Path
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:forest-path:8.Summary: The Ihana can move through the forest at double their normal movement rate.

holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:pathfinder:9.Name: Pathfinder
holy-toikalokke-lynx-power:pathfinder:9.Summary: The Ihana can travel through otherwise impassable forest or shrubbery when desired.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Name: Earth Wall
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Summary: The Ihana causes a wall of earth to shoot up from the ground for protection.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Name: Control Fire
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Summary: The elf can control fire to a limited extent.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:purif.Name: Purify Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:purif.Summary: The spell filters water and removes all dangerous and unhealthy substances from up to 10 liters of liquid.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:gift-.Name: Gift of Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:gift-.Summary: The Ihana feels right at home in the water, as if it were their natural environment (allowing the character to swim even without the Swim specialty).

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Name: Fire Tamer
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Summary: The Ihana can create or extinguish up to 1 cubic meter of fire per action round, within the designated range.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:shape.Name: Shape Earth
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:shape.Summary: The Ihana can transform 1 cubic meter of earth into mud and then shape it according to their will.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:eleme.Name: Elemental Arrow
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:eleme.Summary: Forms an arrow of elemental force and hurls it at a chosen target.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Name: Earthquake
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:earth.Summary: The spell causes an area within the range to rumble with a single, heavy tremor.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:sprin.Name: Spring of Water
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:sprin.Summary: The Ihana can cause a spring of cold, fresh water to emerge from the ground (the game master decides whether the conditions are too extreme to allow this).

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Name: Control Wind
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:contr.Summary: The spell creates a blast of compressed air that rushes with incredible speed at one or more targets.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:hot-a.Name: Hot and Cold
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:hot-a.Summary: The Ihana can control the temperature.

holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Name: Fire Resistant
holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements:fire-.Summary: Protects the recipient from heat, flame, and supernatural fire.

Theme.vitner-body-vitner: Magic that alters bodies and senses, restrains creatures, and enhances speed, strength, or resilience.
Theme.vitner-delusion-vitner: Illusions that manipulate sound, appearance, concealment, landscapes, silence, and invisibility.
Theme.vitner-dimvitner: Death magic that speaks with, summons, controls, dismisses, or drains the undead and the powers of Dimhall.
Theme.vitner-flame-craft: Fire magic that creates heat and flame, protects against fire, and controls conflagrations.
Theme.vitner-perceiving: Divinations for finding places, beings, objects, undead, routes, and the surrounding terrain.
Theme.vitner-power-of-thought: Mental magic affecting language, courage, fear, memory, telepathy, control, possession, and thought reading.
Theme.vitner-power-of-vision: Sight magic for tracking, remote observation, astral travel, reading vitner, and seeing truth.
Theme.vitner-soil-craft: Earth magic that moves or shapes soil and stone, creates tremors and quagmires, and petrifies creatures.

Theme.holy-gerbanis-power-of-enken: Powers granting courage, will, soul sight, night vision, and increasingly mighty storm armor.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-strength-of-stormi: Battle blessings that grant giant strength, commanding voices, divine guards, and heroic warriors.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-warmth-of-sunvei: Solar powers of healing, warmth, light, summer, hunting, and restoration.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-wisdom-of-windinna: Powers of inspiration, truth, creativity, mental resolve, protection, and Windinna's insight.
Theme.holy-gerbanis-wrath-of-tyrd: War powers of fiery weapons, terrifying cries, battle fury, firestorms, and victory.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-gift-of-thanja: Nature powers for animal speech and shapes, concealment in the wild, and communion with forest beings.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-halawen-s-offering: Ancestral protections against fear, bloodfangs, hostile vitner, and supernatural assault.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-heritage-of-majne: Heroic draughts and royal blessings for slaying trolls, giants, and dragons and rallying warriors.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-magh-s-gift: Songs and bonds that aid travel, riders, harvests, heroes, and the changing seasons.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-nema-s-usefulness: Powers that sharpen animal senses, reveal trails, remove restraints, and hasten journeys.
Theme.holy-ealdtradition-tribute-of-morgu: Blood-fueled battle powers that provoke rage and unleash volleys, fire, and murderous fury.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-anger: Sacred powers of blood, stone, martyrdom, destructive bolts, bursts, and divine purging.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-grace: Merciful powers that heal, restore life and memory, recall allies, and preserve them from death.
Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-the-knight: Knightly blessings that empower armor, spears, authority, sacred weapons, and holy battle forms.

Theme.holy-tenetnid-tablet-of-the-sun: Solar signs and sacred radiance that protect homes and groves, reveal omens, and illuminate darkness.

Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-scale: Lindwurm powers of terror, regeneration, stone limbs, petrification, and monstrous resilience.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-the-thurses: Troll and thurse powers granting icy hides, immense strength, breath weapons, and destructive rage.
Theme.holy-haminges-power-of-trolls: Troll powers of disease, illusion, persuasion, fearlessness, cunning, and mountain enchantment.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-animal-mind: Powers for befriending, tracking, speaking with, mastering, and assuming the forms of animals.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-lynx-power: Feline gifts of hearing, leaping, reflexes, aim, tracking, concealment, and pathfinding.
Theme.holy-toikalokke-master-of-elements: Elemental powers controlling earth, fire, water, wind, temperature, and elemental projectiles.

bodyControl.Description: The Body Control discipline develops the character’s ability to get the most out of their agility to duck, climb, land softly on their feet after a fall, and so on. The discipline can also be used to make flips in the air and engage in other acrobatic maneuvers. The penalties on attacks with the shield hand are reduced by 1 point per level
bodyControl.Summary: The character makes the most of agility to dive, climb, land softly and perform acrobatics; shield-hand attack penalties are also reduced.

ambidexterity.Description: The character improves their ability to fight even with the shield hand (which is the left hand for a right-handed person or vice versa). The penalties on attacks with the shield hand are reduced by 2 points per level. By learning all levels of the Ambidexterity specialty and the Body Control discipline, the character becomes equally skilled at using both hands. The modifiers from both Discipline and Specialty are stacked in order to offset the penalty for the shield hand. Once both Body Control Discipline and the Ambidexterity Specialty have been mastered to the highest level, the -15 penalty to the shield hand is completely nullified. The Agility skill is used in most cases when a person performs something with their body. It may be, for example, when a character jumps, climbs, does a handstand, balances, falls and lands on their feet, or leaps away from a runaway horse. In addition to these maneuvers, Agility is used in a number of other physical situations, such as when the character drives a wagon or sleigh, canoes, skis or rides a horse. Remember that in all these situations wearing armor will affect the results. In all areas, it is ultimately up to the game master to determine when a Skill roll is needed, and what modifiers the character receives in each situation.
ambidexterity.Summary: Improves fighting with the shield hand by reducing its penalty; taken to the top alongside Body Control, it grants competence with both hands.

jestering.Description: The character has learned to perform with fire, juggling, and other jester tricks. The knowledge enables them to breathe fire, pull their hands through flame, and juggle. When the game master requires a Skill roll, the character can add +2 to their Skill Value per level in this specialty.
jestering.Summary: Teaches jester tricks: juggling, spitting fire and passing hands through flames.

jumpingClimbingBalancing.Description: The character is adept at jumping in different environments and can add +2 to their Skill Value in the ability to jump. With a successful Skill roll, they can leap up to 2 meters + 1 meter per level in length (maximum 7 m), jump up to 60 cm + 20 cm per level in height (maximum 1.6 m), and fall up to 3 meters + 1/2 meter per level (maximum 6 m) without getting hurt. A successful Jumping roll for falls from heights also reduces the damage dice by one level (3d6 points of damage becomes 2d6, and so on). When a character wants to leap farther, jump higher, or fall farther than the level permits, it is up to the GM to set a suitable modifier on the Skill roll. The character is also good at climbing and balancing. While balancing, they move at about a third of their movement ability under normal conditions. While climbing, they move at about a fifth of their movement ability under normal conditions. Ultimately , the GM determines how far a character climbs or balances during an action round based on the prevailing conditions.
jumpingClimbingBalancing.Summary: Expertise in jumping and climbing: the character leaps farther and higher and handles falls better.

swimming.Description: The character has learned to swim (without this knowledge, they cannot swim) and can add +2 to their Skill Value per level in the ability. They can normally move +1 meter per level per action round in the water, and hold person evading has a -4 modifier on their chance to succeed. The character cannot do anything else besides try to evade during that action. During a combat round, the character can evade one attack at specialty levels 1-2, two attacks at levels 3-4, and three attacks at level 5.
swimming.Summary: Allows swimming, moving through water and holding breath for extended periods.

horsemanship.Description: The Horsemanship discipline develops the character’s ability to ride animals sitting up and to drive a chariot pulled by four-footed animals.
horsemanship.Summary: Lets the character ride four-legged animals and drive their teams.

drivingWagon.Description: The Driving Wagon specialty develops the character’s ability to drive a wagon coupled to one or more draft animals. Skill rolls are normally required only during hunts, chases or in difficult terrain or weather conditions.
drivingWagon.Summary: Develops driving animal-drawn wagons, mainly useful during chases or over rough terrain.

riding.Description: The character has learned to ride a horse and is able to do maneuvers on horseback. Because of this, they get +2 on their Skill Value per level in the specialty whenever they try to ride fast, get the horse to jump, or do other tricks. The Riding specialty can also be used in conjunction with long rides, when battles are fought, or for complications in the wild. Each combat round that a rider fights on horseback, they must pay 15 (-3 per specialty level) Combat Points. So at full specialty level, there is no extra cost for fighting on horseback. More information on Mounted Combat is in the Game Master Guide book, page 95.
riding.Summary: Lets the character ride horses and perform maneuvers on their backs, even at full gallop.

battleManeuver.Description: This discipline grants improvements in moving in battle and wearing armor. The bonus modifier is used only in conjunction with the Evade specialty.
battleManeuver.Summary: Gathers the specialties easing combat movement and armor use.

combatMovement.Description: A person with this specialty can move quickly and effortlessly during battle. They can move 1 meter per level (maximum 5 m) without spending Combat Points and beyound the maaximum movement. After moving that distance, the character must spend 2 Combat Points for every additional meter they want to move.
combatMovement.Summary: Lets the character cover extra ground during combat without spending Combat Points.

evade.Description: The character has learned to evade an attack without parrying. To successfully evade an attack, they make a Skill roll modified negatively by the attacker’s degree of success, which is the amount by which they beat their target SV (SV – dice result = modifier). For example, if the attacker has SV 14 and rolls 10, the Riding The character has learned to ride a horse and is able to do maneuvers on horseback. Because of this, they get +2 on their Skill Value per level in the specialty whenever they try to ride fast, get the horse to jump, or do other tricks. The Riding specialty can also be used in conjunction with long rides, when battles are fought, or for complications in the wild. Each combat round that a rider fights on horseback, they must pay 15 (-3 per specialty level) Combat Points. So at full specialty level, there is no extra cost for fighting on horseback. More information on Mounted Combat is in the Game Master Guide book, page 95.
evade.Summary: Refines the art of dodging attacks rather than parrying them; at higher levels multiple dodges become possible.

ironclad.Description: The person finds it easy to move and maneuver in armor. Their worn armor is counted as if it has 1 less in Heft (-1) for each level of specialty (minimum Heft of 1) to assess the armor modifiers the person receives.
ironclad.Summary: Makes wearing armor easier by reducing its effective encumbrance.

handler.Description: The person has learned management and administration in various forms. It can be anything from controlling a village or town to planning wars and campaigns. The handler is the one behind a city’s prosperity and knows why taxes are needed, who runs the administration, and what they do. Even if the handler does not know everyone personally , they know which authorities are responsible for which tasks.
handler.Summary: Covers management and administration from village to town, up to planning wars and campaigns.

commander.Description: The person has become proficient in the management of armies and warfare, how to move troops, what it takes to entertain troops, and which defenses should be built around the squad. In short, the specialty covers everything connected with managing armies and waging war.
commander.Summary: Masters commanding armies: troop movements, distractions and squad defenses.

sage.Description: The person has gained great insight into the city’s management and administration (or into that of the country , later in their careers). Therefore, they may be involved in solving the city’s or country’s problems.
sage.Summary: Grants deep understanding of town or country administration to help resolve its problems.

handicraft.Description: The character is good at building and crafting things. This discipline is linked to three different craft groups, Counterfeiting, Hard materials and Soft materials, and each has their own specialty.
handicraft.Summary: Lets the character build and shape objects, split into counterfeiting and hard or soft materials.

counterfeiting.Description: The person has learned to forge impressive objects that appear as close to the original as possible. The more time they spend with the original, the more difficult it is to see through the counterfeit. The person must also have the specialty that the material requires.
counterfeiting.Summary: Enables convincing copies of objects, improved by studying the original.

hardMaterials.Description: The character has learned to make and repair items of hard materials such as stone, metal, wood, and bone. In case of repairs, a successful Skill roll restores 2 in the Breach Value per level of specialty and requires one hour of work.
hardMaterials.Summary: Crafting and repairing objects of stone, metal, wood and bone.

softMaterials.Description: The character has learned to make and repair items of soft materials such as what items can and cannot be sold, who can or should be bribed, and so on. The person knows what papers are required for admission to a town or for receiving approval to conduct their trade. The person has also learned to appraise objects in terms of the current price and what they could get by selling it elsewhere.
softMaterials.Summary: Crafting and repairing objects of cloth, fur and leather.

tradesman.Description: The person has learned to operate a farm, an inn, a barber shop, or a trade that offers other services. Through this skill, they also know who to bribe when something needs to be smuggled or how to evade taxes.
tradesman.Summary: Teaches running a farm, tavern or shop while knowing the trade’s ways, from taxes to bribes.

barber.Description: The person has learned to cut and shave hair, and also to pull out “evil” teeth.
barber.Summary: Cuts hair, shaves beards and extracts bad teeth.

brewer.Description: The person has learned to prepare delicious drinks. The brewer knows how to produce everything from mead and wine to the strongest of spiced spirits.
brewer.Summary: Brews every kind of drink, from mead to the strongest spiced spirits.

cook.Description: The person has learned how to cook good food.
cook.Summary: Teaches how to cook good food.

peasant.Description: A peasant knows when and how to carry out animal care or trade in their farm’s goods. They also know what it takes for a farm to survive the winter and are well versed in what needs to be done from day to day.
peasant.Summary: Knows how to tend animals, sell the farm’s goods and see it through winter.

trader.Description: The person has learned where to buy goods cheaply and sell them at a higher price elsewhere. The trader also knows what taxes to pay on goods, what it costs to transport the goods in different ways, trades Man (d) The person has learned to operate a farm, an inn, a barber shop, or a trade that offers other services. Through this skill, they also know who to bribe when something needs to be smuggled or how to evade taxes.
trader.Summary: Knows how to buy cheap and sell high while mastering taxes, transport and trade paperwork.

healingDrugs.Description: The Healing and Drugs discipline teaches a person to mend and care for the sick and wounded so they recover faster than normal, as well as to impair others’ health through drugs or poisons. Tending to wounds and illnesses requires one of the specialties below; rolls made with the discipline’s knowledge alone (without any specialty) can only stop bleeding and keep the patients’ conditions from worsening.
healingDrugs.Summary: Lets the character care for the sick and wounded and make good use of remedies and extracts.

extractsPotions.Description: The person has learned what substances cause the body to react in a certain way. In addition to the extract preparation, this specialty includes what can happen to a person exposed to a particular extract and what can help the victim overcome the drug’s effect. The person has learned to recognize a specific extract depending on its taste, smell, appearance, and effect when someone has been exposed to it. After determining the extract involved, the character knows what can be used as an antidote to neutralize the effect. The character has also learned to improve the balance of the body and speed healing by applying various substances. For this specialty , everything from diseases to broken limbs and wounds count as injuries.
extractsPotions.Summary: Knows how substances affect the body: preparing extracts, identifying poisons and aiding their victims.

firstAidNursing.Description: The character has learned to tend wounds. Any injury treated immediately (within ten minutes) heals at a rate of 1 health point per specialty level, provided the treated injury actually caused that health loss. The character can care for the sick and wounded so they recover faster than normal — though this requires the patient to rest and receive the necessary treatment throughout the day. The healer must spend at least two hours per care attempt on a patient; a successful Skill roll means the patient heals twice as fast.
firstAidNursing.Summary: Attends to wounds quickly to speed recovery and cares for the sick and convalescent.

gambling.Description: The person has learned to play cards, stone, dice, and other forms of gambling, which often results in profit. This discipline gives the person the knowledge to succeed at the most common and best-known games in Trudvang. When making a Skill roll involving gambling, the character can add +1 to their Skill Value.
gambling.Summary: Covers games of chance and social play: knowing the rules of Trudvang’s most common games in order to profit from them.

cheater.Description: The person has learned different tricks to cheat in games. Cheating consists of a positive modifier to the Skill roll’s Skill Value. The cheating player decides the size of the modifier, that is, how much they want to cheat (maximum modifier of +10). Upon a successful Skill roll, the game master determines whether the opponent discovers the cheat or not based on the circumstances, the situation, the opponent, and the cheater’s skill level. Opponents always get a chance to see through the cheat with a roll for the Shadow Arts skill (or the Gambling discipline or Cheater specialty , if those are higher). If the cheater’s Skill roll fails, the opponent gets the same positive modifier that the cheater used when trying to cheat.
cheater.Summary: Teaches tricks for cheating at games; the scale of cheating is chosen by the player, with a risk of being caught.

gameStrategist.Description: The person is good at seeing the smartest moves in strategic games such as Koke’s Boxes, Bultconan, and Ship on Fire. The person can add +2 to their Skill Value in the ability when playing a strategic game of any kind.
gameStrategist.Summary: Makes the character adept at strategy games, moving their pieces to best effect whatever the game.

greatGambler.Description: The person is an accomplished gambler. They know how game rules work and how much and when to invest to win as much as possible. The person can add +2 to their Skill Value in the ability when playing games. The specialty is effective only if the game has a stake.
greatGambler.Summary: Makes the character an accomplished gambler who knows when and how much to stake to maximize winnings.

musicDancing.Description: The discipline gives a person the ability to entertain others through music. The character can sing, dance, and play instruments, as well as use many narrative techniques.
musicDancing.Summary: Lets the character entertain an audience through music: singing, dancing, playing instruments and storytelling.

dance.Description: The person knows how to dance. They can add +2 to their Skill Value in the skill when trying to capture an audience’s interest through dance.
dance.Summary: Teaches dancing so as to capture and hold an audience’s attention.

singingPlayingInstruments.Description: The person has a good voice that can captivate an audience. The specialty also gives them the ability to play music on most of Trudvang’s instruments. They can add +2 to their Skill Value in the ability to sing or play instruments. This skill includes all kinds of entertainment. A person with this skill has learned the rules for gambling and social games and can take part in such activities. They can also sing common songs or tell of an event or legend with a skill great enough to spellbind an audience. The person can perform common dances and act or pretend to be others (which may include dressing up in costume to increase the authenticity of their acting).
singingPlayingInstruments.Summary: Grants a beautiful voice and mastery of most Trudvang instruments to enchant an audience.

storytelling.Description: The person has learned the art of storytelling. They know how to speak and act to evoke a certain mood among listeners and can, without much preparation, come up with a story about anything or tell epic legends.
storytelling.Summary: Masters the storyteller’s art: inventing tales on any subject or recounting epic legends while setting the mood.

acting.Description: The person has learned, through acting, to express feelings in such a poignant manner that every observer is able to understand what they feel. The person knows how to speak and act to elicit a specific mood. By speaking mournfully , they can make listeners gloomy , and by speaking inspiringly , they can rally others.
acting.Summary: Expresses feelings so movingly that every spectator shares them, enough to sadden or rally a crowd.

libel.Description: The person can tell a false and undermining story about someone. The speaker often uses a real event but twists it to make the victim look bad. By succeeding with libel, the speaker can make a crowd disapprove of the intended victim.
libel.Summary: Forges slanderous tales woven from twisted truths to turn a crowd against its target.

godFocus.Description: This discipline represents a deep focus on the religious practices linked with invocation of divine powers. It helps the dimwalker with modifiers per level as follows: +1 on situation rolls to remain focused while distrurbed and -1 to rolls on the table for fatal failure.
godFocus.Summary: Deepens religious practices tied to invocation: resisting distractions better and limiting Fatal Magic risks.

composed.Description: The dimwalker is rarely disturbed when invoking a divine feat and knows how to limit disasters. Anytime they must make a Situation roll to see if they’re disturbed enough to cancel the invocation is modified by +2 per level. When rolling on the Table for Fatal Failure subtract -2 per level of this specialty
composed.Summary: Shields the conjurer from distractions while invoking divine power and softens critical failure consequences.

lightningQuickInvocation.Description: The dimwalker has learned to invoke a divine feat extra quickly , which gives +2 per level on the initiative.
lightningQuickInvocation.Summary: Allows invoking divine power at remarkable speed, benefiting initiative.

potent.Description: The dimwalker’s divine abilities are extra powerful. When a victim makes a Situation roll to avoid or stand up to a divine ability , the roll is modified by -2 per level due to the dimwalker’s force.
potent.Summary: Makes divine feats especially forceful: their victims struggle to resist them.

rigorous.Description: The faithful one knows how to spend power to increase the chances of success. By using extra Divinity Points during the summoning, the chance of success is increased. For each level of the specialty , the faithful one can use 2 Divinity Points to obtain a modifier of +1 on the Skill roll. Thus, a faithful one with level 3 in the specialty can transform 6 Divinity Points into a +3 on the Skill roll, and a faithful one with level 5 can transform 10 Divinity Points into a +5 on the roll. The faithful one decides how many Divinity Points to use, up to the amount allowed by the specialty level.
rigorous.Summary: Teaches investing extra Divinity Points into an invocation to improve its odds of success.

divinePower.Description: This discipline gives the human dimwalker the ability to get power (in the form of Divinity Points from their deity) and thus greater divinity capacity. The sum of the discipline’s Divinity Points constitutes the dimwalker’s divinity capacity. Therefore, a dimwalker at first level has access to 3 more Divinity Points per day , while a dimwalker at fifth level has access to 15 more Divinity Points per day. By learning one or more levels of a specialty associated with this discipline, the dimwalker can increase their divinity capacity even further. Dwarves who acquire this discipline receive as many Divinity Points as humans, but since these are specifically tied to items, the points are consumed as soon as they are inserted into the object.
divinePower.Summary: Grants access to the deity’s power as Divinity Points, forming the conjurer’s daily divine reserve.

faithful.Description: level The faithful one has delved deeply into religion and gains a further +7 Divinity Points per level to their divinity capacity. Dwarves get +7 Divinity Points per level to insert into an object.
faithful.Summary: Deepens the faithful one’s devotion and steadily enlarges their Divinity Point reserve.

powerful.Description: level The dimwalker has learned to draw extra power from the divine source and adds +7 Divinity Points per level to their divinity capacity. Dwarves get +7 Divinity Points per level to insert into an object.
powerful.Summary: Teaches drawing more power from the divine source to further swell the divine reserve.

invoke.Description: This discipline gives the faithful the ability to call on their religion’s divine powers using Holy Tablets (sets of divine abilities). To be able to invoke a divine power, the faithful must also learn one of the Stormkelt The dimwalker has chosen to indulge in the religion of Gerbanis and can learn to invoke the gods to activate supernatural powers. By obtaining the Holy Tablet (Gerbanis) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the divine powers in the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 in Skill Value for performing blood gifting, which in turn gives the Stormkelt additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions. Holy Tablet (Selected Tablet) The faithful learns a Holy Tablet’s divine abilities in a specific Holy Tablet associated with their religion. Each cult has its own prerequisites for allowing access to Holy Tablets. The details are explained in Dimwalkers. By learning this specialty , the faithful can invoke any divine feat that exists under the selected Holy Tablet at that level. Each new level of the specialty provides all the divine abilities included in the Tablet’s new level and in all the previous levels. For example, a faithful who learned the third level of the Holy Tablet (Power of Enken) specialty may invoke the divine feats that belong to the first three levels.
invoke.Summary: Grants the faithful one the power to call on their religion’s divine might through Sacred Tablets.

bruid.Description: The dimwalker has chosen to indulge in the religion of the Eald Tradition and can learn to invoke the Flowras and their ancestors to activate supernatural powers. By acquiring the Holy Tablet (the Eald Tradition) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the divine abilities in the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 in Skill Value per level for performing blood oaths, which in turn give the bruid additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions.
bruid.Summary: Dedicates the conjurer to the Elder Way: invoking Flowras and the ancestors through their Sacred Tablet.

gavlian.Description: The dimwalker has chosen to indulge in the religion of the Tenet of Nid and can learn to invoke the god Gave to activate supernatural powers. By getting the Holy Tablet (the Tenet of Nid) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the divine powers of the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 in Skill Value per level for performing prayers, which in turn provides the gavlian with additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions.
gavlian.Summary: Dedicates the conjurer to the Nid Doctrine: invoking the god Gave through its Sacred Tablet.

ihana.Description: The elf has chosen to indulge in the religion of Toikalokke and can learn to decipher the stars through which to activate the elven divine abilities. By getting the Holy Tablet (Toikalokke) specialty , the faithful can invoke the godly powers in that Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 in Skill Value per level for performing stargazing, which in turn provides the Ihana with additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions.
ihana.Summary: Dedicates the elf to the Toikalokke faith: reading the stars to reach the elven divine feats of its Sacred Tablet.

noaj.Description: The dimwalker has chosen to indulge in the religion of Haminges and can learn to invoke the spirits to activate supernatural powers. By obtaining the Holy Tablet (Haminges) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the divine powers of the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 Skill Value per level for stealing their victims’ spirits, which in turn provides the Noaj with additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions.
noaj.Summary: Dedicates the conjurer to the Haminges faith: summoning spirits and harvesting victims’ souls through its Sacred Tablet.
